name: @n/adira.ts
description: API type builder for seamless, strongly-typed backend integrations.
author: Rata Sorin <ratasorin0@gmail.com>

scripts.build: npm run build:read && npm run build -w packages/generator && npm run build -w packages/cli
scripts.build:read: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/backend && npm run build -w packages/client
scripts.test: npm run test:read && npm run test -w packages/generator -- --runInBand
scripts.test:read: npm run build:read && npm run test -w packages/backend
scripts.demo:read: npm run build:read && npm run demo:read -w packages/backend
scripts.stress:build: npm run build:read && npm run build -w examples/stress
